en.headline: Observatory forecasts very hot weather on Wednesday, possibly record late date
en.dek: Under the influence of a strong El Niño and a strengthening anticyclone, the maximum temperature on 21 October could reach 33 degrees or above at the Observatory.

zh.headline: 天文台料下周三日間酷熱 或破年內最遲酷熱紀錄
zh.dek: 受超強厄爾尼諾及高空反氣旋影響，風勢微弱，若周三最高氣溫達33度或以上將刷新最遲酷熱日子紀錄。

en.headline: Hong Kong China International Tattoo Exhibition runs through Sunday at SoHo House
en.dek: More than 60 local and international artists are showing work at the three-day event in Sheung Wan, which includes an AI try-on system and a competition on the final day.

zh.headline: 香港中國國際紋身展2026於上環SoHo House舉行至周日
zh.dek: 超過60位本地及國際紋身師參展，設AI試紋身系統，周日有比賽，門票由200元起。

en.headline: Saltwater pipe bursts in Tin Shui Wai, spraying two storeys high
en.dek: The Water Supplies Department said flushing water to Tin Yuet Estate and part of Tin Chung Court was suspended and expected to resume at 7.30am on Sunday.

zh.headline: 天水圍爆鹹水管水柱噴兩層樓高 天悅邨及天頌苑停沖廁水
zh.dek: 水務署指涉事為直徑150毫米鹹水供水管，天悅邨及部分天頌苑沖廁水暫停，預計周日早上7時半恢復。

en.headline: Restaurant manager arrested after staging Amoy Plaza cash snatch report
en.dek: Police said a 22-year-old woman handed about HK$11,000 in company takings to a friend in a stairwell before reporting a robbery.

zh.headline: 淘大商場梯間「搶劫」原來是預先安排 食肆經理被捕
zh.dek: 警方指22歲女子與友人約定後交出約一萬一千元公司現金，再報案指被搶走，閉路電視顯示過程不符。

en.headline: Mark Six first prize rolls over after no winner in 111th draw
en.dek: The Hong Kong Jockey Club said the winning numbers were 3, 13, 27, 29, 30 and 40, with special number 9, and the jackpot will carry forward.

zh.headline: 六合彩第111期頭獎無人中 基金滾存至下期
zh.dek: 馬會公布中獎號碼為3、13、27、29、30及40，特別號碼9，下期頭獎估計約一千九百萬元。

en.headline: Police arrest two men linked to Sun Yee On after Granville Road brawl
en.dek: Officers recovered a chopper and rattan cane after a Friday evening fight in Tsim Sha Tsui that left one man injured.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀加連威老道打鬥 警方拘捕兩名新義安相關男子
zh.dek: 周五傍晚十多名男女在街頭混戰，一名男子受傷，警方在現場檢獲開山刀及藤條。

en.headline: EMSD orders all lift contractors to review 10 years of landing door works
en.dek: Contractors must confirm fire-resisting performance of landing doors and frames fitted between October 2017 and October 2026 and file declarations by 15 November.

zh.headline: 機電署要求全港升降機承辦商審視十年來層站門抗火效能
zh.dek: 承辦商須於11月15日前交回聲明書，確認2017年10月至2026年10月期間更換或增設的層站門及門框符合耐火規格。

en.headline: Fire Services Department steps up inspections ahead of APEC finance meeting
en.dek: Special patrols and enforcement will cover the Convention and Exhibition Centre, MTR stations, chemical suppliers and petrol stations before the 20-21 October gathering.

zh.headline: 消防處為APEC財長會議加強巡查及執法
zh.dek: 特別安排涵蓋會議展覽中心、港鐵站、化工供應商及油站等，確保10月20至21日會議順利舉行。

en.headline: Legislative Council uses AI for first time to analyse five-year plan debate
en.dek: President Starry Lee said the tool processed about 450,000 words of remarks from 88 lawmakers, with livelihood protection taking nearly 30 per cent of coverage.

zh.headline: 立法會首次以人工智能分析五年規劃及施政報告辯論發言
zh.dek: 李慧琼指秘書處分析約45萬字逐字紀錄，完善民生保障環節佔整體篇幅近三成，人才及北部都會區最受關注。

en.headline: Police call repeat iPhone Duo credit-card reports extremely regrettable
en.dek: More than 110 reports involving about HK$4.6 million have been logged; officers say Apple has still not enabled 3D Secure despite earlier advice.

zh.headline: 警方稱iPhone Duo信用卡舉報再現極度遺憾 批蘋果未啟用3DS
zh.dek: 網絡安全及科技罪案調查科高級督察盧震綱指接獲逾110宗報案、涉款約460萬元，最大一宗近23萬元，暫未有人被捕。

en.headline: Law says she is confident Hong Kong will reach 53.8 million visitors this year
en.dek: The culture, sports and tourism secretary cited double-digit growth in the first nine months and strong Golden Week arrivals, despite fewer short-haul visitors from higher fuel prices.

zh.headline: 羅淑佩稱有信心全年訪港旅客達5380萬人次
zh.dek: 文化體育及旅遊局局長指首九個月錄得約4070萬人次、按年雙位數增長，國慶黃金周內地客超預期，惟短途市場受燃油價格影響。

en.headline: Hongkong Land opens 15-day Halloween carnival with installations in Central
en.dek: Four large light installations including a giant eyeball appear at Statue Square Garden from today until 31 October; most areas are free to enter.

zh.headline: 置地公司中環萬聖節狂歡祭今日啟動 皇后像廣場設四大裝置
zh.dek: 活動由今日至31日一連15天舉行，巨型眼球等裝置於下午四時起亮燈，大部分區域免費開放。

en.headline: Ka Ying Rising finishes second in The Everest, ending 21-race winning streak
en.dek: The Hong Kong-trained sprinter, ridden by Zac Purton, was beaten by a neck by I Wish I Win at Randwick on Saturday.

zh.headline: 「嘉應高昇」澳洲珠穆朗瑪峰錦標屈居第二 連勝紀錄告終
zh.dek: 由潘頓策騎、大衛希斯訓練的短途馬王自第十一檔出發，以一頸位之差不敵「動心」，跨季21連勝終止。

en.headline: Police seize 32 kg of ketamine worth over HK$12 million in Sha Tin public housing raid
en.dek: Officers arrested a 28-year-old man and two 15-year-old girls after finding the drugs packed with old clothes; the three are due in court on Monday.

zh.headline: 警方沙田公屋檢獲約32公斤氯胺酮 拘28歲男及兩名15歲少女
zh.dek: 毒品調查科周五下午行動中起出市值逾1200萬元懷疑氯胺酮，三人將於周一在屯門裁判法院提堂。

en.headline: Police arrest 75-year-old man over hammer damage and faeces at Tsui Ping North Estate
en.dek: A resident was detained after staff found five smashed windows and faeces on the door of a shared kitchen in Tsui Mei House this morning.

zh.headline: 觀塘翠屏北邨七旬翁被捕 涉鐵錘砸共用廚房五窗兼大門塗糞
zh.dek: 今早約八時屋邨職員發現翠楣樓共用廚房五道玻璃窗被毀及大門有糞便污漬，警方拘捕75歲陳姓男子並檢獲鐵錘。

en.headline: Woman robbed of HK$11,000 cash in Amoy Plaza stairwell in Ngau Tau Kok
en.dek: A 22-year-old woman was pushed from behind and had cash snatched late on Friday night while heading to an ATM; police are seeking a man in a grey sweatshirt.

zh.headline: 牛頭角淘大商場梯間女子被搶走約一萬一千元現金
zh.dek: 二十二歲女子周五晚約十一時在商場梯間被男從後推撞並搶走現金，警方正追緝穿灰色長袖衛衣男子。

en.headline: Police receive over 100 reports of credit card charges linked to iPhone Duo pre-orders
en.dek: Complaints of duplicate or unauthorised transactions began after Apple opened online pre-orders at 8pm on Friday, with sums running into the millions of dollars.

zh.headline: 警方接獲逾百宗iPhone Duo預購信用卡扣款舉報
zh.dek: 蘋果周五晚八時開放摺疊式手機預購後，市民紛紛反映重複或未經授權交易，涉及金額達數百萬元。

en.headline: Husband arrested after wife reports theft of Rolex and handbags worth HK$450,000 in Yau…
en.dek: A 40-year-old man was detained after his 34-year-old wife reported that a Rolex watch and three designer bags had gone missing from their Ocean One flat on Saturday morning.

zh.headline: 油塘丈夫被拘 妻報稱家中勞力士及手袋失竊涉約四十五萬元
zh.dek: 三十四歲女子今早報稱油塘Ocean One單位內勞力士手錶及三個名牌手袋失竊，警方拘捕其四十歲丈夫。

en.headline: Hong Kong Ballet premieres Dunhuang: In Search of Light at Cultural Centre
en.dek: The new work, inspired by Mogao Caves and Hermann Hesse’s Siddhartha, runs until Sunday with performances at 2:30pm and 7:30pm today.

zh.headline: 香港芭蕾舞團世界首演《敦煌：溯光行》於文化中心上演
zh.dek: 由胡頌威及麥靜雯編舞，靈感來自敦煌壁畫及赫塞《流浪者之歌》，今明兩日下午及晚上仍有演出。

en.headline: Police arrest 53 in Double Hammer operation targeting triad drug and vice activities
en.dek: Officers seized about 3.6 kg of cannabis products worth nearly HK$1 million and raided a public-housing packaging centre and a Wan Chai private club.

zh.headline: 警方「雙錘」行動打擊三合會黃賭毒 拘捕53人檢獲3600克大麻
zh.dek: 港島總區聯同入境處行動，包括柴灣公屋毒品包裝中心及灣仔私人會所，檢獲市值約100萬元毒品。

en.headline: Helicopter lifts woman after she vomits blood while hiking near Sai Kung Danjiawan
en.dek: A middle-aged woman in a group of 16 was airlifted conscious to Eastern Hospital after sudden cramps and vomiting blood on Saturday morning.

zh.headline: 西貢蛋家灣中年婦行山突吐血抽筋 直升機救起送東區醫院
zh.dek: 16名女子今早由黃石碼頭出發，其中一名中年婦近蛋家灣時不適，清醒由政府飛行服務隊直升機送院。

en.headline: Hospital Authority to open 15 family medicine clinics on Chung Yeung holiday Monday
en.dek: Services will run from 9am to 1pm and 2pm to 5pm on 19 October; patients can book by phone, eHealth or HA Go.

zh.headline: 醫管局公布重陽節翌日15間家庭醫學診所提供門診服務
zh.dek: 十月十九日公眾假期上午九時至一時及下午二時至五時開放，市民可經電話、醫健通或HA Go預約。

en.headline: Fire on moored barge at Ngong Shuen Chau extinguished after about 90 minutes
en.dek: Firefighters put out a blaze on a pontoon near Ang Yan Road by 11:18am on Saturday; 15 people were evacuated and no injuries were reported.

zh.headline: 昂船洲貲船起火約九十分鐘後救熄 十五人疏散無人傷
zh.dek: 消防今早近十時接報昂船洲昂運路對開貲船火警，十一時十八分大致救熄，呼籲受煙霧影響市民留室內關窗。

en.headline: Six people assault woman with hammers and steal cash and phone in To Kwa Wan
en.dek: A 43-year-old woman was injured in the hands and feet after being attacked at her flat on Wing Yiu Street this morning; police are hunting the suspects who knew her.

zh.headline: 土瓜灣唐樓女子遭六人持錘施襲 掠走三千元及手機
zh.dek: 今早約七時永耀街一單位女住戶被認識人士持錘毆打，手腳受傷送伊利沙伯醫院，警方列襲擊及盜竊追查。

en.headline: Observatory issues yellow fire danger warning as risk remains high
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the yellow fire danger warning at 9:45am on Saturday, urging the public to prevent fires and hikers to stay vigilant.

zh.headline: 天文台發出黃色火災危險警告 指火險頗高
zh.dek: 天文台今日上午9時45分發出黃色火災危險警告，呼籲市民防止火災發生，遠足人士亦須提高警覺。

en.headline: Tang says 999 upgrades will add real-time video and AI prioritisation by 2028
en.dek: Callers could use WhatsApp or WeChat to send live images of incidents, with information shared instantly to the Fire Services Department.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強：999將增實時視像及人工智能分流 目標2028年啟用
zh.dek: 市民日後可用WhatsApp或微信拍攝現場，報案資訊即時傳送消防處，火警等優先處理。

en.headline: 11-year-old boy found unconscious at Fanling home later confirmed dead
en.dek: Police received a report from the boy's father at about 6am on Saturday; ambulance officers confirmed death at the scene and investigations continue.

zh.headline: 粉嶺欣翠花園11歲男童家中昏迷 當場證實不治
zh.dek: 今早約6時父親報案，救護員到場證實男童明顯死亡，警方正在調查死因。

en.headline: Security chief expects Huanggang port to exceed 100,000 daily crossings over Chung Yeung
en.dek: Daily traffic has averaged over 80,000 since the new port opened, with Friday topping 92,000; waiting times remain under 15 minutes.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強料重陽長假新皇崗口岸高峰日過關人次破10萬
zh.dek: 新口岸近日日均逾8萬人次，周五超過9.2萬，等候時間一般少於5分鐘，效率較舊口岸提升至少四倍。

en.headline: Police investigate oil attacks on two Yau Ma Tei restaurants within 38 minutes
en.dek: Red oil hit a Portland Street cha chaan teng and black oil a Bowring Street dim sum shop early Saturday; no arrests and no injuries reported.

zh.headline: 油麻地兩食肆38分鐘內遭淋油 警列刑事毀壞追查
zh.dek: 砵蘭街茶餐廳招牌染紅油，寶靈街點心店則被淋黑油，暫無人被捕，亦無人受傷。

en.headline: Transport bureau to review bus fare applications of up to 17.7 per cent carefully
en.dek: Citybus seeks the largest rise while KMB asks for 16 per cent; lawmakers at Friday's panel meeting criticised the scale and raised service issues.

zh.headline: 運物局稱審慎處理巴士加價申請 加幅介乎8.1%至17.7%
zh.dek: 城巴申請加價17.7%為最高，九巴申請16%，立法會交通事務委員會周五討論時議員批評加幅過高。

en.headline: Chief Executive accepts recommendation to appoint New Zealand judge to top court
en.dek: Sir Terence Arnold would become the sixth non-permanent judge from other common law jurisdictions, subject to Legislative Council endorsement.

zh.headline: 行政長官接納推薦委任新西蘭法官為終審法院海外非常任法官
zh.dek: 區諾德爵士將成為第六名來自其他普通法司法管轄區的非常任法官，仍待立法會通過。

en.headline: HKEX targets T+1 settlement for cash market in second half of 2028
en.dek: The exchange operator received broad support in consultation and will adopt a three-layer implementation framework, with Southbound Stock Connect following the same cycle.

zh.headline: 港交所目標2028年下半年實施港股現貨T+1結算周期
zh.dek: 諮詢獲市場廣泛支持，將採三層實施方案，港股通同步過渡。

en.headline: Hong Kong Wine and Dine Festival returns to harbourfront from 29 October
en.dek: The four-day event organised by the Tourism Board will feature more than 340 booths at Central Harbourfront and Tamar Park, with later hours on Friday and Saturday.

zh.headline: 香港美酒佳餚巡禮10月29日起重返中環海濱
zh.dek: 旅發局主辦的四日盛事設逾340個攤位於中環海濱活動空間及添馬公園舉行，周五六延長至凌晨1時。

en.headline: Citybus extends B14 to all-day service on trial from Saturday
en.dek: The Kai Tak to Huanggang Port express route will run throughout the day until 1 November, with northbound services from 8am to 9pm.

zh.headline: 城巴B14周六起試辦全日服務往返啟德及皇崗口岸
zh.dek: 北上班次由上午八時至晚上九時，南下班次至晚上十一時，試辦期至十一月一日，最快約四十分鐘可達口岸。

en.headline: Customs seize 8.8 kg of cannabis buds at airport in two passenger cases
en.dek: Two mainland travellers were arrested over suspected cannabis found in carry-on baggage, with cases listed for West Kowloon court on Saturday.

zh.headline: 海關機場連破兩宗販毒案 檢約8.8公斤大麻花拘兩內地客
zh.dek: 兩名內地旅客手提行李藏懷疑大麻花被捕，案件周六在西九龍裁判法院提堂，估計總市值約183萬元。

en.headline: Buildings Department orders checks on eight more houses at One Stanley
en.dek: The developer updated its sales brochure after the department required investigations of additional detached houses following earlier rebar irregularities.

zh.headline: 屋宇署要求One Stanley再查八座獨立屋鋼筋問題
zh.dek: 發展商更新售樓書，披露屋宇署於十月二日要求就另外八座洋房及公用地方進行調查，一個月內提交報告。

en.headline: Government to roll out four new signature tourism projects from fourth quarter
en.dek: The batch includes industrial brand tours at bus depots and MTR exhibits, a miniature city display at the Peak, temple digitalisation and Yuen Long seasonal events.

zh.headline: 政府第四季起推四項新特色旅遊項目涵蓋工業品牌及廟宇文化
zh.dek: 項目包括九巴車廠及港鐵展覽參觀、山頂微型城市展、廟宇數碼化，以及元朗季節性地區活動。

en.headline: Customs seize HK$50 million in counterfeit hard disks, arrest six in Tuen Mun
en.dek: Officers raided five industrial units and found about 6,800 suspected counterfeit disks plus 20,000 second-hand units awaiting processing.

zh.headline: 海關屯門搞冒牌硬碟工場拘6人 檢值約5000萬貨
zh.dek: 關員搜查五個工廈單位，檢獲約6800個懷疑冒牌硬碟及2萬個待加工二手硬碟。

en.headline: Tourism Board launches first Halloween Month with citywide cosplay parties
en.dek: Street celebrations begin on Saturday in Central, Lan Kwai Fong, Mong Kok, Tsim Sha Tsui East and Kai Tak, with free admission at several venues.

zh.headline: 旅發局首辦「香港萬聖月」全城Cosplay街頭派對今日啟動
zh.dek: 中環、蘭桂坊、旺角、尖東及啟德多區周六起舉行街頭慶祝活動，多個場地免費入場。

en.headline: Police arrest three over missing fire door frames in public estate lift works
en.dek: A company director and two registered engineers were detained on fraud suspicions after EMSD found 48 lifts at two estates lacked required components.

zh.headline: 警方拘捕三人涉公屋升降機工程欠裝耐火門框
zh.dek: 機電署發現兩屋苑48部升降機未裝所需門框組件，一名董事及兩名註冊工程師因涉嫌欺詐被扣留。

en.headline: Fire Services Department deploys AI-assisted drones and extra patrols for Chung Yeung…
en.dek: More than 250 frontline staff will form 12 patrol teams at high-risk sites in the New Territories, with drones sending live images for real-time smoke detection.

zh.headline: 消防處重陽節前動員逾二百五十人巡邏 引入AI無人機協助偵測山火
zh.dek: 超過250名前線人員組成12支巡邏隊進駐新界高風險地點，無人機影像實時傳送AI平台識別煙霧。

en.headline: Five Guangdong yachts make first arrival under new southbound travel scheme
en.dek: The vessels from Shenzhen, Nansha and Zhuhai docked at Lantau Yacht Club on Friday after the scheme took effect, with a welcome ceremony attended by senior officials.

zh.headline: 五艘廣東遊艇在「粵艇南下」新計劃下首次抵港
zh.dek: 來自深圳、南沙及珠海的遊艇周五偽晚停泊大嶼山遊艇會，高層官員出席歡迎儀式。

en.headline: M+ opens Myths and Monsters exhibition exploring fantasy in Asian visual culture
en.dek: The special exhibition runs from 17 October 2026 to 4 April 2027 at the West Gallery, presenting more than 400 works spanning the nineteenth to twenty-first centuries.

zh.headline: M+「神話與怪獸」展覽周六開幕 探討亞洲視覺文化中的奇幻
zh.dek: 特別展覽由今天至2027年4月4日在西展廳舉行，展出逾400件橫跨十九至二十一世紀的作品。

en.headline: West Kowloon court imposes three-month hospital order on woman convicted of displaying…
en.dek: The 62-year-old was found guilty of knowingly displaying publications with seditious intent after materials including a colonial-era flag were found outside her Tin Shui Wai flat.

zh.headline: 西九龍法庭裁定六旬婦展示煲動刊物罪成 判三個月住院令
zh.dek: 62歲女子被指在天水圍天頌苑單位外張貼港英期旗幟及標語，被裁定明知而展示具煲動意圖的刊物罪成。

en.headline: Housing Bureau says 93.2 per cent of Wang Fuk Court owners signed sale agreements…
en.dek: A total of 1,850 owners across the eight blocks completed the Agreement for Sale and Purchase after the October 15 deadline, with remaining cases to be handled individually.

zh.headline: 房屋局指王福苑九成三業主在截止前簽署買賣合約
zh.dek: 八座樓宇共有1,850名業主完成買賣合約，佔總數的百分之九十三點二，餘下個案將個別處理。

en.headline: Police arrest two men over Kowloon break-in spree worth HK$1.7 million
en.dek: A 54-year-old mainland man and a 34-year-old local man were detained over at least nine residential burglaries in Kowloon since July, with losses including cash, watches and jewellery.

zh.headline: 警方拘捕兩男涉九龍區連環爆竊 損失約170萬
zh.dek: 54歲內地男子及34歲本地男子被控涉及自七月以來至少九宗住宅爆竊，失物包括現金、手錶及珠寶。

en.headline: Science Museum opens Future Science Prize Exhibition until 18 November
en.dek: The ground-floor show highlights this year's three laureates and past Hong Kong winners through multimedia and interactive displays on topics including autophagy and mesoporous materials.

zh.headline: 科學館舉行2026未來科學大獎展覽至11月18日
zh.dek: 地下展覽廳以「生活中的科學」為題，介紹本年度三位得主及歷年香港獲獎者，設多媒體互動展品。

en.headline: Observatory forecasts fine and dry weather for Chung Yeung weekend
en.dek: Rain patches are expected on Saturday and Sunday morning before conditions turn mainly fine and dry from later on the Chung Yeung Festival through early next week.

zh.headline: 天文台預測重陽節周末轉晴乾燥
zh.dek: 周六及周日早上有一兩陣雨，重陽節稍後至下周初大致天晴及乾燥，中期日間炎熱。

en.headline: HKEX targets second half of 2028 for T+1 settlement
en.dek: The exchange published consultation conclusions showing broad support for shortening the cash-market cycle from T+2, while delaying the earlier proposed 2027 timeline after industry feedback.

zh.headline: 港交所目標2028年下半年過渡至T+1結算
zh.dek: 諮詢總結顯示市場廣泛支持將現貨市場結算周期由T+2縮短，但因業界要求更多準備時間，較早前提議的2027年時間表已推遲。

en.headline: Buildings Department orders investigation of eight more One Stanley houses
en.dek: The developer updated its sales brochure on Friday to disclose a 2 October letter requiring detailed checks and a report within one month on the original villa plus eight others and common areas.

zh.headline: 屋宇署要求One Stanley發展商調查額外八座洋房
zh.dek: 發展商周五更新售樓書，披露本月2日接獲署方函件，須就涉事洋房及另外八座洋房連公用地方在一個月內提交詳細調查報告。

en.headline: Sham Shui Po woman dies after melioidosis infection
en.dek: The 74-year-old with underlying illnesses was admitted with pneumonia and tested positive for the bacterium; the Centre for Health Protection says the case appears sporadic.

zh.headline: 深水埗74歲女子感染類鼻疽後離世
zh.dek: 患者有長期病患，因肺炎入院後樣本對類鼻疽伯克氏菌呈陽性，防護中心指個案屬散發，正調查感染源頭。

en.headline: Police arrest man over pouring liquid on women at Tsim Sha Tsui MTR
en.dek: A 26-year-old man faces three indecent assault charges and one wounding charge after incidents in January and early October at the station and a nearby mall.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀港鐵站淋液體案 警方拘捕26歲男子
zh.dek: 男子涉嫌在一月及十月初於港鐵尖沙咀站及附近商場向女性淋潑不明液體，將被控三項猥褻侵犯及一項傷人。

en.headline: Chief Executive accepts recommendation to appoint former New Zealand judge as CFA…
en.dek: The appointment of the retired New Zealand Supreme Court permanent judge will take effect after Legislative Council approval, raising the number of overseas non-permanent judges to six.

zh.headline: 行政長官接納推薦 任命新西蘭前最高法院常任法官為終院非常任法官
zh.dek: 區諾德獲任命後，其他普通法適用地區非常任法官將增至六名，須立法會同意後生效。

en.headline: Transport Department sets special arrangements at Huanggang control point for Chung Yeung
en.dek: Bus and minibus frequencies will be increased from Saturday as cross-boundary flows rise, with Monday afternoon to evening expected to be the peak return period.

zh.headline: 運輸署皇崗口岸重陽節實施特別交通安排 料下周一下午至傍晚為回港高峰
zh.dek: 周六起加密專營巴士及小巴班次，呼籲市民提早計劃行程，按需要選擇其他口岸過關。

en.headline: Centre for Health Protection records two imported chikungunya and one dengue case
en.dek: The two chikungunya patients had visited the mainland during the incubation period; the dengue case was linked to travel in Cambodia. Both diseases remain mostly imported this year.

zh.headline: 衛生防護中心錄得兩宗輸入性基孔肯雅熱及一宗登革熱個案
zh.dek: 兩名基孔肯雅熱患者潛伏期內曾到內地，登革熱個案與柬埔寨行程有關，今年個案大多為外地傳入。

en.headline: Housing Bureau opens applications for all 13 light public housing projects
en.dek: With the final two school-conversion sites due in the first quarter next year, the full portfolio of about 30,000 units will be complete by end-March, ahead of the original five-year target.

zh.headline: 房屋局宣布簡約公屋13個項目全部開放接受申請
zh.dek: 最後兩個校舍改建項目明年首季落成，約3萬個單位將於明年三月底前全部完成，提前達標。

en.headline: Police arrest company director and two engineers over lift works deficiencies
en.dek: New Territories South Regional Crime Unit detained three men aged 63 to 82 after EMSD referred findings of missing fire-door frames at two estates.

zh.headline: 警方拘捕臺日電梯董事及兩名註冊工程師 涉升降機工程缺失
zh.dek: 新界南總區重案組拘捕三名63至82歲男子，機電署早前轉介兩屋邨耐火門框組件未裝便報完工的個案。

en.headline: Customs seizes about 6800 suspected counterfeit hard disks worth HK$50 million
en.dek: Officers raided a suspected processing factory and warehouse on Thursday and arrested six people in the operation targeting fake computer storage devices.

zh.headline: 海關檢約6800件懷疑冒牌硬碟 拘6人 市值約5000萬
zh.dek: 海關周四採取特別行動，搗破懷疑冒牌硬碟加工工場及倉庫，檢獲約6800件貨品並拘捕六人。

en.headline: Fire Services to step up patrols at 12 high-risk sites ahead of Chung Yeung
en.dek: More than 250 personnel will form 12 teams with Civil Aid Service members, while new large drones carrying 80 litres of water and AI image analysis will support operations.

zh.headline: 消防處重陽節加強巡邏12個山火高危地點 引入大型無人機
zh.dek: 聯同民安隊組成12支巡邏小隊，並動用遙距偵測、人工智能影像分析及可載80公升水彈的大型無人機協助。

en.headline: Order gazetted granting privileges and immunities for Interpol General Assembly
en.dek: The subsidiary legislation implements an agreement between the Central People’s Government and Interpol for the 94th General Assembly and related Executive Committee session in Hong Kong next month.

zh.headline: 國際刑警組織大會特權及豁免權令刊憲
zh.dek: 有關附屬法例落實中央人民政府與國際刑警組織的協議，適用於下月在港舉行的第94屆全體大會及執委會會議。

en.headline: Working Group to launch four new tourist hotspot projects from fourth quarter
en.dek: The initiatives cover industrial brand tours including KMB depots, a miniature city exhibition at The Peak, temple cultural routes and seasonal Yuen Long experiences.

zh.headline: 發展旅遊熱點工作組第四季起推四個新項目
zh.dek: 項目涵蓋九巴車廠及鐵路展等工業品牌遊、山頂微型城市展、廟宇文化深度遊及「元朗好時節」。

en.headline: 93.2 per cent of Wang Fuk Court owners sign sale agreements before deadline
en.dek: The Housing Bureau says 1850 owners from the eight blocks completed the process by Thursday, with remaining cases involving special circumstances to be handled individually.

zh.headline: 宏福苑93.2%業主限期前簽署買賣協議
zh.dek: 房屋局指八座共1850戶業主於周四前完成簽署，餘下特殊個案將按情況酌情處理。

en.headline: ICAC charges five over technology voucher fraud involving shell companies
en.dek: A technology services provider and four others face conspiracy to defraud charges after an operation intercepted nearly 90 per cent of more than HK$100 million in suspected subsidies.

zh.headline: 廉署起訴科技服務供應商等5人 涉空殼公司詐騙科技券
zh.dek: 一名科技服務供應商及四名空殼公司負責人與中間人遭控串謀詐騙，廉署指成功阻截近九成涉贎資助。

en.headline: Government to hold ceremony for Sun Yat-sen's 160th birth anniversary
en.dek: An official event will take place on 12 November at Sun Yat Sen Memorial Park, with special stamps and community activities also planned.

zh.headline: 政府將於11月12日舉行孫中山誕辰160周年紀念儀式
zh.dek: 官方儀式在孫中山紀念公園舉行，郵政局同日發行特別郵票，並有一系列社區活動。

en.headline: Video shows rat on counter near utensils at Yuen Long restaurant
en.dek: A clip circulating online late Thursday appears to show a rodent moving along a serving counter with cutlery and drinks in a Yoho Town eatery.

zh.headline: 元朗YOHO TOWN食肆片段顯老鼠在柜位遊走 近餐具飲品
zh.dek: 周四深夜網上流傳短片，可見一隻老鼠在食肆出菜柜位上移動，附近有餐具及飲品。

en.headline: Observatory forecasts mainly cloudy weekend with light rain patches
en.dek: A fresh easterly airstream will bring windier conditions and a few rain patches on Saturday and Sunday before the weather turns finer and drier early next week.

zh.headline: 天文台料周末大致多雲有一兩陣雨 下周初轉天晴乾燥
zh.dek: 受清勁偏東氣流影響，周六及周日風勢較大，有一兩陣雨，重陽節初時雲量較多，稍後至下周初漸轉天晴乾燥。

en.headline: Police to patrol Wan Chai round the clock ahead of APEC finance ministers meeting
en.dek: Hundreds of officers will cover the district from Friday as delegates begin arriving for the October 19-21 gathering at the Convention and Exhibition Centre.

zh.headline: APEC財長會議將至 警方周五起灣仔24小時巡邏
zh.dek: 數百名警員由周五起在灣仔區全日巡邏，迎接即將抵港的代表，會議19至21日在會展中心舉行。

en.headline: Guangdong yachts make first southbound voyage to Hong Kong today
en.dek: A ceremony this afternoon will welcome the first batch under the simplified scheme, with five vessels already approved and 300 captains qualified for local waters.

zh.headline: 粵艇南下今日首航 下午舉行儀式迎接首批遊艇
zh.dek: 署理財政司司長黃偉綸及運輸及物流局局長陳美寶等官員將出席，已有五艘獲批，300名船長取得本港水域資格。

en.headline: Hand, foot and mouth disease activity rises sharply in schools
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection recorded nine institutional outbreaks involving 24 people in the first three days of the week, with about 90 per cent in child-care centres, kindergartens or primary schools.

zh.headline: 手足口病活躍程度顯著上升 本周首三日已錄9宗爆發
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心指涉及24人，約九成發生在幼兒中心、幼稚園或小學，專家提醒用梘液洗手至少20秒。

en.headline: AIRSIDE opens Kuromi Starlit Sweet Party with six-metre macaron installation
en.dek: The dessert-themed event at the Kai Tak mall runs until early November, with a bakery experience on selected dates from this weekend and a limited-time themed menu.

zh.headline: 啟德AIRSIDE呈獻Kuromi魔幻烘焙所 6米馬卡龍裝置
zh.dek: 甜點主題活動至11月初，本周末起有選日烘焙體驗，六樓亦有期間限定主題餐單。

en.headline: Man arrested after cleaver attack on colleague at Fan Kam Road village house
en.dek: Police detained a 48-year-old man on Thursday afternoon after he allegedly attacked a co-worker with a cleaver during an argument at staff quarters in Yuen Long.

zh.headline: 粉錦路村屋同事爭執 48歲男持菜刀斬傷被捕
zh.dek: 周四下午約兩時，元朗粉錦路一間村屋內兩名同事因琐事爭執，一名48歲男子涉嫌持菜刀襲擊45歲同事，已被警方拘捕。

en.headline: Science Park and Roche upgrade partnership to end-to-end support for medtech startups
en.dek: The Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation and Roche signed a strategic agreement to expand collaboration on AI-enabled early screening and clinical translation for local innovators.

zh.headline: 科技園與羅氏簽署戰略協議 升級端到端支援醫療科技初創
zh.dek: 香港科技園公司與羅氏周四簽署協議，將2023年起的合作提升至端到端轉化及商業化支援，聚焦AI輔助癌症與慢性病早篩及本地初創臨床轉化。

en.headline: Police arrest driver after Mercedes hits three vehicles while fleeing in Kwun Tong
en.dek: A Pakistani man was detained on Thursday evening after a rented Mercedes struck several cars in Kwun Tong; officers found etomidate, methamphetamine and cocaine inside the vehicle.

zh.headline: 觀塘平治逃捕連撞三車 警拘巴基斯坦裔司機檢獲毒品
zh.dek: 周四晚上約七時，一輛租來的平治在觀塘撞及多部車輛後企圖逃走，警方在崇仁街截獲，車上檢獲依托咪酯、冰毒及可卡因。

en.headline: Hong Kong records net loss of 40 kindergartens amid falling births
en.dek: The Education Bureau’s latest profiles show 930 kindergartens operating, a record annual net decrease of 40 as the student population shrinks and first-time mothers grow older.

zh.headline: 本港幼稚園按年淨減40間 創紀錄跌幅
zh.dek: 教育局最新概覽顯示全港約有930間幼稚園運作，按年淨減40間，為歷來最高，學生人口持續萎縮。

en.headline: Hong Kong China International Tattoo Exhibition opens at Soho House
en.dek: More than 60 tattoo artists from Hong Kong and overseas gather at Sheung Wan’s Soho House from Friday to Sunday, with live work, an AI try-on feature and a competition on the final day.

zh.headline: 香港中國國際紋身展於上環Soho House開幕
zh.dek: 逾60位本地及海外紋身師周五至周日雲集上環德輔道西Soho House，有即場創作、AI試紋功能及最後一天比賽。

en.headline: Fire breaks out in Sham Shui Po tenement staircase, no injuries
en.dek: Clutter caught alight in the back staircase of a building on Un Chau Street early Friday; firefighters extinguished the blaze within minutes and no one was evacuated.

zh.headline: 深水埗唐樓後樓梯雜物起火 無人受傷毋須疏散
zh.dek: 周五凌晨元州街一幢唐樓後樓梯雜物起火，消防在數分鐘內撲滅，沒有人受傷或需要疏散。

en.headline: Hong Kong Electronics Fair Autumn edition enters final day at HKCEC
en.dek: The HKTDC-organised fair and concurrent electronicAsia feature more than 3200 exhibitors focusing on AI, robotics and future industries until 5pm today.

zh.headline: 香港秋季電子產品展進入最後一天 會展聚焦AI與機械人
zh.dek: 貿發局主辦的秋電展及同期電子組件展匯聚逾3200家展商，周五下午5時結束，重點展示人工智能、機械人及未來產業。

en.headline: Hong Kong Ballet premieres Dunhuang: In Search of Light this weekend
en.dek: The world premiere runs 16-18 October at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre, fusing classical ballet with Dunhuang imagery and Hermann Hesse's Siddhartha.

zh.headline: 港芭《敦煌：溯光行》本周末世界首演
zh.dek: 作品16至18日於香港文化中心上演，結合古典芭蕾、敦煌意象及赫塞《流浪者之歌》。

en.headline: Major Sports Events Committee awards M Mark to three international tournaments
en.dek: The Link Hong Kong Open, Hong Kong Cricket Sixes and Prudential Hong Kong Tennis Open receive the status for events later this month and next.

zh.headline: 大型體育活動事務委員會授予三項國際賽事M品牌認證
zh.dek: 領展香港高爾夫球公開賽、香港六人板球賽及保誠香港網球公開賽獲認證，分別於本月底及下月初舉行。

en.headline: EMSD finds serious deficiencies in Tai Yip lift works at two estates
en.dek: Forty-eight lifts at Tsui Ping North and Pok Hong Estates were reported complete without fire-door frames; the department is referring the case to police and ordering repairs within a month.

zh.headline: 機電署發現臺日電梯兩屋邨換𨋢工程嚴重缺失
zh.dek: 翠屏北邨及博康邨共48部升降機未裝耐火門框卻報稱完工，署方將事件轉介警方，並限一個月內完成執修。

en.headline: Hospital Authority appeals for liver donor for 13-year-old boy
en.dek: The boy at Queen Mary Hospital is in serious condition with severe liver failure and complications, topping the O+ waiting list as officials prepare to seek mainland assistance.

zh.headline: 醫管局呼籲為13歲男童尋找肝臟捐贈者
zh.dek: 男童現於瑪麗醫院留醫，情況嚴重，肝功能衰竭並有併發症，位列O+血型輪候名單首位，當局正準備向內地尋求協助。

en.headline: Three injured in Kwun Tong Bypass three-vehicle collision
en.dek: A private car struck a Citybus and another car near MegaBox on Thursday evening, briefly trapping a driver and closing the Yau Tong-bound lanes.

zh.headline: 觀塘繞道三車相撞釀三人受傷
zh.dek: 周四晚上近MegaBox一輛私家車撞及城巴及另一私家車，一名司機一度被困，往油塘方向全線封閉。

en.headline: Science Museum opens Future Science Prize exhibition until mid-November
en.dek: The free-with-permanent-ticket show at Tsim Sha Tsui runs from Friday to 18 November and introduces the prize, Hong Kong laureates and interactive displays on past winning fields.

zh.headline: 科學館「2026未來科學大獎展覽」周五起展出至11月中
zh.dek: 尖沙咀科學館地下展覽廳即日起至11月18日開放，常設展門票已包括，介紹大獎、本港歷年得獎者及互動展品。

en.headline: Election Committee receives 29 more nomination forms on day nine
en.dek: Returning officers took in 26 candidate forms and three from designated bodies on Thursday, lifting the cumulative totals to 1,112 and 38 respectively ahead of the October 20 close.

zh.headline: 選委會選舉提名期第九日再接獲29份提名表格
zh.dek: 選舉主任今日接獲26份候選人提名表格及3份指定團體提名表格，累計分別達1112份及38份，提名期將於10月20日結束。

en.headline: Hospital Authority to suspend Lok Ma Chau emergency hospital for upgrades
en.dek: Facility optimisation works starting next Tuesday cover ceiling insulation, flooring repairs, air-conditioning maintenance and a backup water tank, with services paused until the first quarter of 2027.

zh.headline: 醫管局公布河套應急醫院下周二起進行設施優化工程
zh.dek: 工程涵蓋更換天花隔熱物料、加固地面、空調保養及加設備用水箱，期間暫停服務，預計明年第一季完成後恢復。

en.headline: Government proposes bilingual price lists for private medical facilities
en.dek: The Health Bureau plans to submit regulations by year-end requiring fixed prices or ranges and pre-admission budget estimates for hospitals, with measures for private hospitals starting as early as August 2027.

zh.headline: 政府擬規定私營醫療機構提供中英雙語價目表
zh.dek: 醫務衛生局計劃年底向立法會提交規例，要求列出固定價格或價格範圍，私家醫院須提供入院前費用預算，措施最早明年8月起適用於私家醫院。

en.headline: Productivity Council opens Hong Kong's first embodied AI robot training ground
en.dek: The facility under the Hong Kong Productivity Council brings together technology and scene partners to test humanoid and other robots in real industrial, logistics and public-service settings.

zh.headline: 生產力局成立本港首個具身智能及人形機械人訓練場
zh.dek: 香港工業人工智能與機械人研發中心設立「具身智能國際應用訓練場」，匯聚技術及場景夥伴，推動機械人在工業、物流及公共服務等實景測試。

en.headline: Police arrest 22 in Sham Shui Po crackdown on high-interest loan syndicate
en.dek: Sham Shui Po crime officers dismantled a group operating two licensed finance companies in Yau Ma Tei that charged effective annual rates above 300 per cent and used intimidation to collect debts.

zh.headline: 警搗高利貸集團拘捕22人 包括主腦及骨幹成員
zh.dek: 深水埗警區刑事部行動中拘捕22人，揭發兩間油麻地持牌財務公司實際年利率逾300%，並以恐嚇及淋油等手段收數。

en.headline: Government to tender Shek Mun site for about 960 private homes
en.dek: The Development Bureau announced the third-quarter land sale programme, saying the first three quarters already exceed the annual private housing supply target of 12,600 units.

zh.headline: 政府推售石門住宅地 料提供約960個單位
zh.dek: 發展局公布第三季賣地計劃，推出沙田石門住宅用地，首三季供應已超全年私人房屋目標12600個單位。

en.headline: Police arrest two over Tai Po gold necklace theft and recover part of chain
en.dek: Officers detained a 37-year-old man and a 29-year-old woman within 24 hours of the theft at a Chow Sang Sang store on Kwong Fuk Road, retrieving part of the 60-gram chain.

zh.headline: 大埔周生生金鏈盜竊案 警方拘捕兩人並起回部分金鏈
zh.dek: 大埔警區重案組今日拘捕一名37歲男子及一名29歲女子，涉於廣福道周生生金行盜取約值7.9萬元、重約60克的金鏈，並起回部分贓物。

en.headline: Police arrest six over HK$14 million agarwood investment scheme
en.dek: Officers raided a Kwun Tong office and warehouse in an operation codenamed Shadow Net after 21 mostly elderly victims reported losses ranging from HK$30,000 to HK$1.9 million.

zh.headline: 警方搗破沉香樹投資騙局拘捕6人涉款1400萬
zh.dek: 商業罪案調查科展開代號「影網」行動，搜查觀塘辦事處及倉庫，21名受害人多為長者，個別損失由3萬至190萬元。

en.headline: HKU forecasts third-quarter growth of 3.7 per cent, full-year 4.1 per cent
en.dek: The APEC Studies Programme revised the annual figure up by 0.4 points on stronger first-half trade, but expects fourth-quarter growth to slow to 2.8 per cent amid weaker consumer confidence.

zh.headline: 港大料第三季經濟按年增3.7% 全年預測上調至4.1%
zh.dek: 亞太經濟合作研究項目指上半年外貿較預期理想，帶動全年預測上調0.4個百分點，但消費者信心疲弱令第三季放緩，第四季料再降至2.8%。

en.headline: Lingnan University drops external English test for graduation
en.dek: Undergraduates must now pass university English courses instead of achieving a set IELTS score; the change took effect immediately after the Senate approved it earlier this week.

zh.headline: 嶺南大學取消本科生校外英語試畢業要求
zh.dek: 學生只需修畢並及格指定校內英語課程即可畢業，取代過往須達雅思指定分數的規定，有關修訂本周教務會通過後即時生效。

en.headline: Security chief Chris Tang receives scam call impersonating bureau officer
en.dek: Tang challenged the caller to find him on the 10th floor of government headquarters after being told he had violated mainland laws and must report for identity checks.

zh.headline: 保安局局長鄧炳強接獲假冒保安局人員詐騙電話
zh.dek: 對方聲稱他涉嫌觸犯內地法律，要求到政府總部十樓核實身份，鄧炳強反邀對方親自到場找他。

en.headline: CK Asset denies rumour of Li Ka-shing's death as utterly without foundation
en.dek: The company condemned mainland self-media accounts that falsely claimed Ta Kung Pao had reported the 98-year-old tycoon's death, and urged verification before sharing.

zh.headline: 長實否認李嘉誠逝世傳聞 指絕無其事並譴責捏造假新聞
zh.dek: 公司指內地自媒體訛稱大公報報道98歲李嘉誠逝世，實屬捏造，呼籲報道或轉載前務必核實。

en.headline: HKMA launches ART framework for responsible AI in banking
en.dek: The framework focuses on accountability, resilience and trust as banks move from generative to agentic artificial intelligence applications.

zh.headline: 金管局公布ART框架推動銀行業負責任應用人工智能
zh.dek: 框架着重可問責、具韌性及可信賴，應對銀行由生成式轉向代理式人工智能應用。

en.headline: Baidu opens free robotaxi public trials in Tung Chung next week
en.dek: Apollo Go vehicles will run a 5.1-kilometre loop from Yat Tung Estate for two weeks starting 21 October, with ride vouchers distributed through the Islands District Council.

zh.headline: 百度蘿蔔快跑下周三起東涌公眾試乘 為期兩周
zh.dek: 自動車每日下午2至6時行走約5.1公里固定路線，由逸東邨出發折返，乘車券經離島區議會派發，每次最多載兩人。

en.headline: Education Bureau posts 2026/27 kindergarten profiles online
en.dek: The overview lists basic information for about 930 kindergartens and kindergarten-cum-child care centres, including fees, staffing, student numbers and support for non-Chinese-speaking and special-needs children.

zh.headline: 教育局發布2026/27學年幼稚園概覽網上版
zh.dek: 載列全港約930所幼稚園及幼稚園暨幼兒中心基本資料，包括學費、師資、學生人數，以及對非華語及有特殊需要學童的支援。

en.headline: Hong Kong Pride Rainbow Market at Central Market cancelled
en.dek: Organisers said the venue cited an administrative error after confirming the booking and receiving a deposit; this is the second year a planned venue fell through after details were announced.

zh.headline: 香港同志遊行彩虹市集因中環街市場地取消
zh.dek: 籌委會指場地確認及收取訂金後以「行政出錯」重複租場為由未能提供場地，已是連續第二年公布詳情後場地出問題。

en.headline: Space Museum opens 3D dome film Explore the Stars until July 2027
en.dek: The 28-minute show in the Sky Theatre runs from 15 October, with standard tickets at HK$30–40 and concession rates of HK$15–20; English screenings are available on Monday and Thursday evenings.

zh.headline: 太空館天象廳新片《尋星探宇3D》上映至明年7月
zh.dek: 28分鐘立體球幕電影即日起放映，標準票30至40元，優惠票15至20元；周一及周四傍晚有英語場。

en.headline: MTR probes two Lam Tin disruptions within 15 hours
en.dek: The operator apologised after a trackside fire and overheating wires forced service skips and suspensions; the government ordered a report within a month.

zh.headline: 港鐵調查藍田站15小時內兩宗故障 政府要求一個月內交報告
zh.dek: 周二晚軌旁絕緣部件起火及周三早月台電房電線過熱，先後影響繁忙時間服務；運輸及物流局局長要求徹底調查並提交報告。

en.headline: ICAC survey finds 99.2 per cent of respondents had no personal encounter with corruption
en.dek: The 2025 annual survey of about 1,500 people recorded the highest such figure on record and a mean tolerance score of 0.3 out of 10.

zh.headline: 廉署調查顯示99.2%受訪者過去一年未親歷貪污 創紀錄
zh.dek: 2025年周年民調訪問約1500人，貪污容忍度平均僅0.3分，97.9%認為社會廉潔對香港發展重要。

en.headline: Happy Valley vegetable stall reports tabby cat Garlic missing
en.dek: Staff at a produce shop on Tsap Tseung Street told police the four-year-old neutered cat was last seen Wednesday evening; an AirTag ping pointed to Tuen Mun early Thursday.

zh.headline: 跑馬地菜檔花貓「蒜頭」失蹤 飼主報警尋貓
zh.dek: 集祥街菜檔職員今早報案，指約四歲已絕育花貓昨晚仍在店內，今晨不見蹤影；項圈追蹤器凌晨一度顯示屯門位置。

en.headline: September visitor arrivals reach 4.03 million, up 22 per cent
en.dek: The Tourism Board said the Mid-Autumn Festival and festive events helped push first-nine-month arrivals past 40.7 million, a 12 per cent rise.

zh.headline: 9月訪港旅客約403萬人次按年升22% 首九個月逾4070萬
zh.dek: 旅發局指中秋假期及多項節慶活動帶動增長，內地客升近三成，全年累計升12%。

en.headline: Fire at Yau Lai Estate unit in Yau Tong leaves five injured
en.dek: Firefighters extinguished a blaze on the ninth floor of Sau Lai House shortly after 10.50am; one woman in her seventies was taken to hospital while about 100 residents were evacuated.

zh.headline: 油塘油麗邨單位起火 初步5人受傷約百人疏散
zh.dek: 秀麗樓九樓單位上午約10時49分起火，消防約29分鐘後將火救熄；約70歲女住戶送聯合醫院，另有4人輕傷毋須送院。

en.headline: Consumer Council reports nearly 2705 customer service complaints this year
en.dek: The figure up to August approaches last year’s full-year total, with common issues including no follow-up, uncontactable service and slow responses; the Council notes AI tools can help but often need human backup.

zh.headline: 消委會今年接獲近2705宗客戶服務投訴 逼近去年全年數字
zh.dek: 截至8月的數字已接近去年全年總數，常見問題包括無人跟進、聯絡不到及跟進緩慢；消委會指人工智能有助提升效率，但仍需真人支援。

en.headline: HKDI exhibition shows rare Leslie Cheung photos until mid-November
en.dek: The free display at the Hong Kong Design Institute in Tseung Kwan O features previously unpublished archival images from the 1980s and 1990s, a concert microphone stand and student works, with advance online…

zh.headline: 知專設計學院張國榮紀念展展出至11月中 免費參觀
zh.dek: 將軍澳展覽包括多幅八九十年代未公開照片、演唱會銀色咪架及逾400名學生作品，需預先網上預約。

en.headline: Police and Immigration arrest 22 in New Territories South operation
en.dek: The joint anti-illegal worker and anti-vice action on Wednesday used small drones for high-altitude patrols and targeted blackspots across several districts.

zh.headline: 新界南跨部門打擊黑工掃黃 拘捕22人
zh.dek: 周三行動代號「冠軍」及「權能者」，使用小型無人機配合地面人員高空巡邏，突擊多個罪案黑點。

en.headline: Man dies after drowning off Kiu Tsui Chau in Sai Kung
en.dek: Police received a report at about 2.42am that someone was drowning; a passing sampan rescued the man and took him to Ho Chung Pier, where he was later pronounced dead at hospital.

zh.headline: 西貢橋咀洲附近有男子溺毙
zh.dek: 警方約凌晨2時42分接報有人遇溺，途經舡艈將男子救起送往蠣湧碼頭，其後在將軍澳醫院證實不治。

en.headline: Police seize 5.7kg of suspected cannabis from Tsuen Wan mini-storage
en.dek: Officers from the Tsuen Wan Police District Special Duties Team arrested a 28-year-old local man after finding about half a kilogramme on him and a further 5kg in a nearby storage unit.

zh.headline: 警方搞破荃灣迷你倉毒品分銷中心 檢獲約5.7公斤大麻花
zh.dek: 荃灣警區特別職務隊截查一名28歲本地男子，在其紙袋檢獲約半公斤懷疑大麻花，其後在附近迷你倉再檢獲約5公斤。

en.headline: Customs seizes 18kg of suspected scheduled dried shark fins at Lo Wu
en.dek: Officers intercepted a 68-year-old mainland woman arriving on Monday and handed the batch, valued at about HK$45,000, to the AFCD for investigation.

zh.headline: 海關羅湖截查內地婦 檢18公斤懷疑瀕危乾魚翅
zh.dek: 周一在入境大堂截獲一名68歲抵港內地女旅客行李內的乾魚翅，估計市值約4.5萬元，已交漁護署跟進。

en.headline: FEHD launches second phase of Operation Skynet targeting public markets
en.dek: The two-week operation will inspect markets for pest and hygiene issues after the first phase focused on supermarkets and restaurants.

zh.headline: 食環署展開「天網行動」第二階段 巡查全港街市
zh.dek: 為期兩周的行動針對街市害蟲及衞生問題，第一階段針對超市及食肆已結束並發出多項通知及檢控。

en.headline: Indonesian domestic helper charged with murder of 93-year-old employer
en.dek: The 52-year-old was remanded after being charged at Kwun Tong Court, following the death of the elderly woman at Tak Long Estate last Sunday.

zh.headline: 印尼外傭被控謀殺93歲僱主 還押候訊
zh.dek: 52歲女外傭周三在觀塘裁判法院被控謀殺，上日在啟德德朗邨單位被發現昏迷的93歲女僱主已證實不治。

en.headline: Police hunt man who snatched gold necklace from Tai Po jewellery store
en.dek: A man in his forties asked to try on a necklace worth nearly HK$80,000 at a Chow Sang Sang shop before fleeing on an airport-bound bus on Wednesday afternoon.

zh.headline: 警方通緝大埔珠寶店掠走金頸鏈男子
zh.dek: 一名約四十歲男子周三下午在廣福道周生生店舖要求試戴近八萬元金頸鏈後掠走，並登上往機場巴士逃走。
